notes: Current conditions and forecast questions. Every case expects the forecast agent and forbids the archive: answering 'what is it now' from historical observations would be a different answer to a different question.

cases.description: Current conditions for one named place, labelled current rather than forecast.
cases.question: What is the weather in Berlin right now?

cases.description: A one-day forecast, the most common question Weathra will be asked.
cases.question: Will it rain in Berlin tomorrow?

cases.description: A week-long horizon, which must be reported with its uncertainty.
cases.question: What is the forecast for Lisbon over the next 7 days?

cases.description: A specific measure rather than a general question, so the answer must name it.
cases.question: How windy will it be in Munich over the next 3 days?

cases.description: An explicitly requested unit system, which must win over any default.
cases.question: What is the temperature in Berlin over the next 3 days?

cases.description: An unresolvable place name is refused by name, with no nearest match substituted.
cases.question: What is the weather in Atlantisborough tomorrow?

cases.description: A question naming no place, with no saved default: asked rather than guessed.
cases.question: Will it rain tomorrow?

cases.description: A saved default location is used and disclosed as the default rather than a guess.
cases.question: Will it rain tomorrow?
